plugin.note: A hybrid encounter requiring at least two styles. Use demonbane or abyssal weapons; carry the second style and appropriate ammunition/runes.

requirements: At least two combat styles and protection prayers.
mechanics: Tormented demons change protection prayer after taking 150 damage and pause their attacks for six ticks.
Non-demonbane and non-abyssal damage is reduced by the fire shield.
The shield drops at the beginning and following fire bombs; a slow crush weapon, heavy ranged weapon, or manually cast spell can exploit the next hit.
Shield-down attack bonuses depend on weapon speed; powered staves do not qualify as spells for this bonus.
After roughly 30 ticks of ordinary combat the demon becomes defenceless, granting 100% accuracy until the first hit after fire bombs.
Fire bombs bind briefly, disable run, and damage their landing areas even after the demon dies. Open spaces offer more escape room.
With two demons one uses melee and the other ranged or magic. A third uses fire bombs, greatly increasing attention.

methods.label: Max Melee/Magic
methods.summary: Use melee with a magic switch whenever the demon protects against the current style. A high-damage hybrid with more equipment switches.
steps: Start with a style the demon does not protect against; change style after its protection prayer changes.
Use the second style as a complete usable setup, including ammunition or spell runes.
Use slow crush or heavy ranged weapons for the shield-down hit; set heavy ranged weapons to Accurate.
Use the defenceless period for suitable special attacks or high damage with fewer accuracy switches.
notes: The setup is a preparation reference; the plugin does not issue live prayer or movement prompts.
Rune quantities are trip-planning defaults, not a guarantee for a full assignment.
If choosing an alternative magic staff, check its autocast compatibility and rune supply.

requirements: Arceuus spellbook with Dark Demonbane and Mark of Darkness selected

switches.name: Purging staff or Toxic staff of the dead

methods.label: Temple transportation
methods.summary: Direct teleport scrolls are fastest; games necklace plus a lit sapphire lantern is the alternative.
steps: Use Guthixian temple teleport scrolls to reach the temple directly.
Alternatively teleport to Tears of Guthix using a games necklace or jewellery box, use a lit sapphire lantern on a light creature, and continue via the chasm and central skull.

methods.label: Fighting two or three demons
methods.summary: Multiple demons change attack timing and shorten shield-down punish attacks.
steps: Two demons use separate melee and ranged/magic attacks; movement can disrupt their attack cadence.
A third demon uses additional fire bombs.
Open terrain reduces the chance of being trapped by bomb landing areas.

advisor.coverageStatus: Procedural alternative reviewed against wiki revision 15332199

methods.label: Shield-down punish alternatives
methods.summary: Slow crush, heavy ranged, and manual spells gain damage and speed on the shield-down hit.
steps: Dharok's greataxe on crush, Heavy ballista on Accurate, Dragon 2h sword, and Tzhaar-ket-om are options.
Full Dharok multiplies the shield-down bonus based on missing health. Tzhaar-ket-om with Berserker necklace multiplies damage.
Godswords must be set to crush to qualify; powered staves do not receive the spell bonus.
A manually cast spell with a slow Dark bow or Ogre bow equipped can exploit weapon speed.

advisor.coverageStatus: Procedural alternative reviewed against wiki revision 15332199

methods.label: Special attacks and trip extension
methods.summary: Healing special attacks, Death Charge and a third-style thrall can extend trips.
steps: Saradomin godsword and Eldritch nightmare staff are sustain options during guaranteed-accuracy periods.
The godsword's flat shield-down bonus does not restore extra health or prayer.
Use a thrall of the third combat style for uptime; it may occasionally trigger a protection-prayer switch.
Death Charge competes with High Alchemy spellbook access; Explorer's ring 4 is an alchemy alternative.
